featured_reviews.name: Dilesh Tanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
I tried their chicken tikka roll, butter chicken roll, chicken pattice, chicken pizza and chicken burger.
The roll and the pattice are good. No complaints with the roll although the pattice was a little too oily but it did taste good.
The pizza is too small. Smaller than you'd expect for sure. It mostly had the tomato taste in the chicken pizza and I don't remember one piece of chicken getting in my mouth from the pizza. It also kinda felt like rubber and didn't taste very good.
The burger had mayonnaise that didn't taste very good. The patty was okay and didn't taste great either. The bun was stale. It was hard and did not taste good.

The first time i ordered from this place, it was a good experience but the second time wasn't. The food delivered to my was cold for which I don't blame the store but the packaging was not good. I ordered 7 items which were all stuffed inside a single packet and the pattice was not even packed. It was just lying in the bag. No ketchup either. The price is good though which is the reason the experience wasn't so bad.

No one was responsive to our table, and we had to repeatedly ask for basic things like menus and service. At one point we literally had to call the restaurant’s phone number just to get someone to bring us the menu.

The food itself tasted good, but the quantity felt surprisingly little for the price. Also the pastry we ordered did not seem fresh at all - it felt old and dry instead of soft and fresh.

Really sad to see the experience go downhill because Oven Fresh was genuinely one of my go-to places earlier.

featured_reviews.review_text: I am Pavan Mhatre from Malad mumbai. Yesterday my wife visited and ordered Rava mava cake from the Bangalore Iyengar bakery, Goregaon East Railway station opposite Anupan stationary shop. Afterthat she asked for show plum cake but sales person who attending my wife was so rude and misbehave to her. And rudely said i have no time to show  you. That time only 2-3 customers are their in shop but his misbehave with women customers. So i requesting to you, their is brand all over in Maharashtra and India, this rude behaviour of sales person is not good for  your brand. Look into seriously into this matter.

featured_reviews.name: Swagat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely horrible and disappointing service.

I had gone to their shop and they basically rebuked Swiggy and Zomato. They promised that free delivery if order is through their phone no with no minimum order value

I tried to order today and first the no in google was wrong. After getting the correct no called again and the bakery fellow started asking for delivery charge or Dunzo charge etc. I am happy to pay the same but at least be transparent.

Don’t promise delivery and then refuse later
